KPIT Technologies Q2FY27 results: Net profit declines 29% to ₹121 crore
items.summary:
KPIT Technologies reported a nearly 29 per cent decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 121 crore in the second quarter ended September, mainly on account of pressure on the automobile market from Chinese vehicle makers slowing down deals.
The company had posted net profit of Rs 169 crore in the same period a year ago.
KPIT expects losses to come down from the third quarter onwards.
"Two of our largest clients are where you have seen a large decline. One is in Europe, one is in Japan. We do believe that both these accounts will bottom out over the next couple of quarters. Two or three quarters at the most is what we are looking at. However, for some of our existing OEMs' clients in passenger cars, trucks and off-highway, we will see growth come bit by bit," KPIT Technologies co-founder and joint managing director Sachin Tikekar said during the company's earnings call.

items.summary: Anup Bagchi has taken charge as the managing director and chief executive officer of HDFC Bank. He succeeds Sashidhar Jagdishan, who completed his tenure on October 26. HDFC Bank acknowledged Jagdishan's contributions in terms of performance and culture during his leadership. The bank expressed optimism for Bagchi’s leadership moving forward in terms of strategic priorities. They provided details regarding both executives in compliance with regulatory requirements effective from October 1.

items.title: Anup Bagchi takes charge as HDFC Bank MD & CEO
Anup Bagchi takes charge as HDFC Bank CEO and MD, succeeds Jagdishan
items.summary:
Country's largest private sector lender HDFC Bank on  Tuesday said that Anup Bagchi has taken charge as its managing director and chief executive.
His predecessor, Sashidhar Jagdishan, vacated office on Monday after the completion of his term, the bank informed exchanges.
Bagchi, an ICICI Group veteran, is the first outsider to head HDFC Bank in its over-three-decade history. His previous assignment was as the MD and CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance.
He joins HDFC Bank at a time when the lender is battling a slew of challenges, including ones on core income growth and margins, which have made investors wary.
In brief comments on an earnings call which he attended, Bagchi said a part of the work on the bank's 2023 merger with housing finance major parent HDFC is yet to be executed and also announced that he will be meeting all the stakeholders to better understand the bank.

items.summary:
LT Foods, the maker of Daawat basmati rice, on Tuesday reported a 10 per cent year-on-year rise in consolidated net profit to Rs 180 crore for the September quarter, while revenue grew 17 per cent to Rs 3,253 crore.
The company's revenue from operations stood at Rs 2,772 crore in the year-ago period. Net profit was Rs 164 crore in the July-September quarter of the previous fiscal.
EBITDA (earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation) rose 13 per cent to Rs 358 crore in the second quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 316 crore a year earlier.
However, profitability margins contracted during the quarter. EBITDA margin declined to 11 per cent from 11.4 per cent a year ago, while net profit margin fell to 5.5 per cent from 5.9 per cent.
Gross profit increased 12 per cent to Rs 1,058 crore during the quarter, compared with Rs 948 crore in the corresponding period last fiscal. Gross profit margin declined to 32.5 per cent from 34.2 per cent.

Tata Capital Q2FY27 results: Net profit surges 51% to ₹1,660 crore
items.summary:
Tata Capital on Tuesday reported a 51 per cent growth in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,660 crore for the September quarter of FY27.
The company had posted a net profit of Rs 1,097 crore in the July-September period of FY26.
Net total income rose 24 per cent to Rs 4,676 crore during the September quarter of FY27, from Rs 3,774 crore in the corresponding period a year ago, the company said in a regulatory filing.
Tata Capital Managing Director and CEO, Rajiv Sabharwal, said the company's loan book crossed Rs 3 trillion, "underscoring the scale, diversification and resilience of our franchise".
The non-bank lender's Assets Under Management (AUM) stood at Rs 3,08,030 crore, up 26 per cent year-on-year.
"Asset quality remained stable, reflecting our continued focus on portfolio quality, prudent underwriting and effective collections," Sabharwal said.
In a separate exchange filing, Tata Capital said its board approved a proposal for the enhancement of the existing medium-term note ..

Tata Capital Q2FY27 results: Net profit surges 51% to ₹1,660 crore
items.summary:
Tata Capital on Tuesday reported a 51 per cent growth in consolidated net profit to Rs 1,660 crore for the September quarter of FY27.
The company had posted a net profit of Rs 1,097 crore in the July-September period of FY26.
Net total income rose 24 per cent to Rs 4,676 crore during the September quarter of FY27, from Rs 3,774 crore in the corresponding period a year ago, the company said in a regulatory filing.
Tata Capital Managing Director and CEO, Rajiv Sabharwal, said the company's loan book crossed Rs 3 trillion, "underscoring the scale, diversification and resilience of our franchise".
The non-bank lender's Assets Under Management (AUM) stood at Rs 3,08,030 crore, up 26 per cent year-on-year.
"Asset quality remained stable, reflecting our continued focus on portfolio quality, prudent underwriting and effective collections," Sabharwal said.
In a separate exchange filing, Tata Capital said its board approved a proposal for the enhancement of the existing medium-term note ..
